classification: source-confirmed leader-role reconstruction from observer-filtered ordering; API conditional
title: Filtered party order substitutes for the actual leader identity
fact: get_active_party_members reads the actual PartyView leader_id, removes members ahead of the observer, sorts surviving members with a surviving actual leader first, and returns only Vec<CharacterView>. profile_membership then calls the first surviving character the leader implicitly when deciding whether the active member can leave. Sorting is a display order and cannot preserve an omitted leader identity.
counterexample: Let actual leader L be omitted by character_not_ahead_of_observer and let active living nonleader A be the lowest-id survivor. The actual producer returns A first; profile_membership(A,returned_members) renders no Leave party action because first.id==A. An otherwise identical projection with visible L renders Leave. No actual DB population or divergent-frontier run claimed.
limits: The admitted divergent-frontier native mutation graph and a concrete ordinary route state remain to be established; the source conditional does not assert present live incidence.

If a caller passes an arbitrary Vec not sorted by leadership the public-in-crate helper likewise lacks explicit role; ordinary caller evidence here is the observer-filtered producer, not a generic unsorted-vector claim.
No permission bypass or unauthorized DB mutation is claimed; this is visible action availability. Root confirmed no exact accepted alias; global dedup remains coordinator-owned.
suggested_connected_remedy: Carry explicit authorized party role or leader identity through the observer projection and derive Leave availability from it. Keep sorting for display only and preserve omission of future member facts.
acceptance_contract: Filtering or sorting visible members cannot change the active character actual leadership role or hide Leave solely because the true leader is absent from the visible list.
